description:
Sheehy Meares Team McCullagh are delighted to present to the market this attractive three-bedroom, three-bathroom detached family home in excellent condition throughout, set on a generous 0.75-acre site approx. Ideally located just minutes from Fohenagh village, the property combines rural charm with modern convenience. Ballinasloe town and the M6 Galway-Dublin motorway are within easy reach, and Woodlawn Train Station is approximately six minutes from the property, making this a highly accessible location for families and commuters alike.

Accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a bright and spacious sitting room, an open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, a utility room, and a guest W.C, three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a master ensuite, along with a family bathroom. With three bathrooms in total, the property offers excellent comfort and practicality for family living.

Externally, the home is further enhanced by beautifully manicured lawns, a tarmacadam driveway surrounding the property, and a storage shed to the rear, providing both practicality and an attractive setting.

The home benefits from a dual heating system, with oil-fired central heating and solid fuel. First offered for sale by private treaty, this property represents a superb opportunity to secure a spacious, well-appointed family home in a desirable location. Fohenagh community centre and sports field nearby, while also being just ten minutes from Mountbellew and a short commute to Ballinasloe and the M6 motorway.

For further details or to arrange a viewing, please contact the auctioneers.
